title: The Disco Cowgirl•3 King Beds•Pool is Open Apr-Oct
description:
Check out this unique Disco Cowgirl themed Airbnb. Its the sweetest little spot for a girls trip or bachelorette. We sleep 6 guests in 3 King size beds with a pool and gym on-site! This spot is stocked with amenities and the cutest decor. Located in downtown Nashville less than a mile from Broadway. We also provide a list of Nashville recommendations to create the perfect itinerary for your trip to Music City. Check us out on Instagrxm @theNashVillas!

The space
*We have a 3 night minimum stay, and a 4 night minimum during popular event weekends. 
*We have a strict no smoking policy.
*The condo is located on the 3rd floor, and there is no elevator in the condominiums.

Planning a bachelorette or girls trip to Nashville… This Airbnb was designed for you from the unique décor to the photo walls and makeup station. We’ve thought of every detail to create the perfect crash pad for a girls getaway. As you walk in, you’re greeted by a champagne wall. Pop some bubbly and enjoy your stay in Music City! 

🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements: Maximum occupancy of 6 people. 
•1 bedroom (Sleeps 4 in a king over king bunk bed)
•Living room (Sleeps 2 in 1 king size murphy bed)
•1 bathroom
•630 square feet (note the small space)

Extras/Amenities:
🎸 Pool (open 7am-10pm April 1 to October 31)
🎸 3 comfy King size beds
🎸 2 sound machines to drown out background noises for a good night sleep. Please note that downtown and condo living comes with its fair share of noises (traffic, trains, barges, construction, music…it is Music City after all). So enjoy those sound machines!
🎸 Makeup station with 3 lighted mirrors
🎸 2 Full length mirrors
🎸 Champagne wall
🎸 Photo walls and a tri-pod for taking photos
🎸 6 cowboy hats available for your use
🎸 Shampoo, Conditioner and Body Wash provided in each shower
🎸 Blow dryer/ hair flat iron 
🎸 Kuerig coffee makers with K-cups
🎸 Kitchens stocked with dishware, silverware, glasses/mugs, barware, etc
🎸 Ninja Blender
🎸 Wi-Fi
🎸 65 inch TV with Roku/all the streaming apps (no cable)
🎸 Clothing iron, ironing board and steamer 
🎸 On-site Gym
🎸 On-site Laundry facility uses a smartphone app payment system (laundry detergent and dryer sheets are provided)
🎸 Free on-site parking
🎸 Newly remodeled (brand new kitchen appliances, A/C unit, floors, bathroom, etc)
🎸 Located riverfront with a balcony overlooking the Cumberland River and pool as well as a view of the iconic Batman building/Nashville skyline 
🎸 1 mile from Broadway

We ask you to please be respectful of our neighbors. The City of Nashville and Davidson County are quick to shut down airbnbs that violate noise ordinances. This is a condo, not a nightclub. If you want to listen to loud music, go to Broadway :)

The condo is located on the 3rd floor, and there is no elevator in the condominiums.

Other things to note
Nashville is rich with live music, shows/events, great food, history and loads of fun. We provide a recommendation list so you can build the perfect itinerary for your trip to Music City. Follow us on Instagrxm @theNashVillas to see what we’re all about.

We have a strict cancellation policy which allows for a 50% refund if you cancel more than 7 days before check-in. We recommend purchasing Airbnb’s trip insurance to protect you should an emergency impact your travel plans.
